sentences.zh: 他们用自己的尿液作为隐形墨水写信，详细描述集中营里发生的恐怖经历。

sentences.en: They were a group of young Polish girls and women who had been part of the Polish underground resistance to the Nazi regime, and they were captured, they were imprisoned,
sentences.zh: 她们是一群年轻的波兰女孩和妇女，曾参与抵抗纳粹政权的波兰地下抵抗运动，她们被捕了，被关进监狱，

sentences.en: and this group were called the Rabbits of Ravensbrück because, and this is horrible, they were subjected to extreme medical experiments like rabbits.
sentences.zh: 这群人被称为拉文斯布吕克的“兔子”，因为——这很可怕——她们像兔子一样遭受了极端的医学实验。

sentences.en: That's why they got this nickname.
sentences.zh: 这就是她们得到这个绰号的原因。

sentences.en: However, they were allowed to write letters to their families back home once a month, but the letters were heavily censored.
sentences.zh: 然而，她们每个月被允许给家乡的家人写一次信，但信件受到了严格的审查。

sentences.en: One of these women remembered that when she was a child, her and her brother had read this series of books where people were writing messages in invisible ink.
sentences.zh: 其中一位女性记起，当她还是个孩子时，她和哥哥读过一套人们用隐形墨水写信的书。

sentences.en: So, they used their urine to write these secret messages, and due to a reaction with the paper, the urine loses its color and becomes invisible, but then if you heat it up,
sentences.zh: 于是，她们用自己的尿液写这些秘密信息，由于与纸张发生反应，尿液会失去颜色变得隐形，但随后如果你加热它，
它就会显现出所写的内容。

sentences.en: And in her first letter to her brother, she wrote about these books that they read as kids, and he figured out the code and knew how to reveal the hidden messages.
sentences.zh: 在她写给哥哥的第一封信中，她提到了他们小时候读过的那些书，哥哥破解了密码，知道了如何显现隐藏的信息。

sentences.en: So, they came up with this code with their families, which was, if the hidden messages were revealed, the families would send back a letter with a little piece of blue string,
sentences.zh: 因此，他们与家人商定了一套密码，那就是，如果隐藏信息被显影了，家人们就会回信并附上一小段蓝线，

sentences.en: and that's how they knew if their messages were being received.
sentences.zh: 他们就是靠这个知道自己的信件是否被收到的。

sentences.en: So, eventually, the contents of these letters and the horrific details of the camp were broadcast on the radio, and the camp was liberated by the Red Army,
sentences.zh: 最终，这些信件的内容和集中营的恐怖细节在电台广播了，集中营被红军解放了，

sentences.en: and the four women who wrote the letters all survived.
sentences.zh: 写信的四位女性全部幸存了下来。

sentences.en: Their letters were used as evidence to prosecute the guards.
sentences.zh: 她们的信件被用作起诉守卫的证据。

sentences.en: And 77 years later, these letters can still be read, because 27 of them are still readable and on display in a museum in Lublin.
sentences.zh: 777年后的今天，这些信件依然可以被阅读，因为其中27封仍然清晰可读，并在卢布林的一家博物馆里展出。
这是一个了不起的故事。

sentences.en: Yeah, I'm just sort of speechless at the gravity of that story and how it's amazing.
sentences.zh: 是啊，这个故事的分量以及它是多么的神奇，让我有点说不出话来。

sentences.en: Well, we got a letter from Conrad F.
sentences.zh: 好啦，我们收到了一封来自康拉德·F 的信，
他来自波兰卢布林，信里说：

sentences.en: I've started listening to your podcast a few months ago while running, and today I listened to the Casual Friday episode.
sentences.zh: 几个月前我开始在跑步时收听你们的播客，今天我听了《随性星期五》那一集。

sentences.en: I was shocked because you were talking about the secret letters written using urine during World War II.
sentences.zh: 我很震惊，因为你们在聊二战期间用尿液写的秘密信件。

sentences.en: I checked, and these letters really are on display in one of the museums in my city.
sentences.zh: 我查了一下，这些信确实在我市的一家博物馆里展出。

sentences.en: I walked by this building probably like a thousand times, and I never knew that.
sentences.zh: 我可能路过这栋建筑大概有一千次了，却从来不知道这件事。

sentences.en: Thanks for the constant entertainment as well as all the random bits of information I learned through your podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你们持续带来的娱乐，以及通过你们的播客学到的各种随机知识。

sentences.en: I'm still amazed that my city was mentioned, even though it was in one of the weirdest contexts I could have ever imagined.
sentences.zh: 我仍然很惊讶我的城市被提及了，尽管这是我能想象到的最怪异的语境之一。

sentences.en: I mean, I would love to see those letters.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我很想看看那些信。

sentences.en: I feel like that would be so powerful.
sentences.zh: 我觉得那一定非常有冲击力。

sentences.en: And I'm so glad they're preserved.
sentences.zh: 而且我很高兴它们被保存了下来。

sentences.en: Well, in revisiting this subject of invisible ink, I found that there are a lot of organic, as they are called, substances that can be used as invisible ink.
sentences.zh: 嗯，在重新探讨隐形墨水这个主题时，我发现有很多被称为有机物质的物质可以用来做隐形墨水。

sentences.en: So urine is considered an organic, invisible ink.
sentences.zh: 所以尿液被认为是一种有机的隐形墨水。

sentences.en: And others are lemon juice, milk, and a sugar water solution.
sentences.zh: 其他的还有柠檬汁、牛奶和糖水溶液。

sentences.en: So like urine, all of these are revealed through applying heat.
sentences.zh: 所以和尿液一样，所有这些都是通过加热来显现的。

sentences.en: Another organic invisible ink is like a candle.
sentences.zh: 另一种有机的隐形墨水就像蜡烛。

sentences.en: Like, I watched a video with a guy who tested different organic invisible inks.
sentences.zh: 比如，我看过一个视频，里面有个家伙测试了各种有机的隐形墨水。

sentences.en: So do you write with the wax and then take the wax off or something?
sentences.zh: 所以你是用蜡写，然后把蜡刮掉还是怎么的？

sentences.en: Well, he used like a birthday candle.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他用的是那种生日蜡烛。

sentences.en: So he didn't melt the wax or anything.
sentences.zh: 所以他没有融化蜡之类的东西。

sentences.en: He just sort of used it kind of like when you write on an Easter egg with like a clear crayon.
sentences.zh: 他只是用它，有点像你在复活节彩蛋上用透明蜡笔写字那样。

sentences.en: And then you put it in the colored water and then it reveals the design.
sentences.zh: 然后你把它放进有颜色的水里，图案就显现出来了。

sentences.en: It was kind of like that.
Because the wax is not revealed through heat.
sentences.zh: 因为蜡不是通过加热显现的。

sentences.en: It's revealed through putting like a colored substance on top.
sentences.zh: 它是通过在上面涂抹有颜色的物质来显现的。
他们就是这样制作蜡染的。

sentences.en: I actually watched him try all of these.
sentences.zh: 我其实看他把这些全都试了一遍。
这是一个非常引人入胜的视频。

sentences.en: I just love that someone, this guy, he was like, I'm going to spend my day testing various organic invisible ink methods.
sentences.zh: 我就是喜欢有人——这个家伙，他当时想的是：我要花一天时间测试各种有机的隐形墨水方法。

sentences.en: I love that you watched his video.
sentences.zh: 我真喜欢你看过他的视频。

sentences.en: I love that I watched a video that was an hour long on the green man throughout like carvings on churches.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢我看了整整一个小时的视频，讲的是绿面人，比如教堂里的各种雕刻。

sentences.en: All the way to King Charles, his coronation invite had the green man on it.
sentences.zh: 一直讲到查尔斯国王，他的加冕典礼邀请函上就有绿面人。

sentences.en: Lady, this is a whole other dive.
sentences.zh: 天哪，这完全是另一个深坑了。

sentences.en: So what else did you watch?
Well, the milk was really good.
sentences.zh: 嗯，那个牛奶真的很好用。

sentences.en: It was really good because it totally disappeared into the paper.
sentences.zh: 真的很好用，因为它完全渗进纸里不见了。

sentences.en: Like he wrote things and all these organic materials and then he let them dry.
sentences.zh: 就像他用各种有机材料写了些东西，然后让它们风干。

sentences.en: And the milk, like you could not see any evidence that there was anything on this paper.
sentences.zh: 而且那个牛奶，你完全看不出这纸上有写过任何东西的痕迹。

sentences.en: It really disappeared into the paper.
sentences.zh: 它真的完全渗进纸里消失了。

sentences.en: And then he revealed it with heat.
sentences.zh: 然后他用加热的方式把它显现出来。

sentences.en: So I'm just saying Dwight did not need to use his urine.
sentences.zh: 所以我只想说，德怀特其实根本不用他的尿液。

sentences.en: He probably could have just gotten some milk from the fridge.
sentences.zh: 他大概只要从冰箱里拿点牛奶就行了。

sentences.en: Or from his cows on the farm.
sentences.zh: 或者用他农场里牛产的奶。

sentences.en: He did not need to give everyone notes with his urine on them.
sentences.zh: 他根本没必要给每个人发写有他尿液的便条。

sentences.en: But before we go, I thought maybe I could write my own invisible message and reveal it
sentences.zh: 但在我们开始之前，我想也许我可以写一份自己的隐形信息，
今天在《办公室女士》节目里把它显现出来。

sentences.en: I used my urine as invisible ink.
sentences.zh: 我用我的尿液当作隐形墨水。

sentences.en: Wait, I have so many questions.
sentences.zh: 等等，我有好多问题想问。

sentences.en: And then you put it in a writing device?
sentences.zh: 然后你把它倒进书写工具里了？

sentences.en: Like the guy in the video, I used a Q-tip.
sentences.zh: 就像视频里的那个家伙一样，我用了一根棉签。

sentences.en: I dipped a Q-tip into my cup of urine.
sentences.zh: 我把棉签蘸进我装尿的杯子里。

sentences.en: And I wrote a secret message to be revealed today.
sentences.zh: 然后我写了一条秘密信息，准备今天揭晓。

sentences.en: I really hope this ends up in People Magazine.
sentences.zh: 我真心希望这事能登上《人物》杂志。

sentences.en: You know that they do me dirty all the time.
sentences.zh: 你知道他们总是把我写得很不堪。

sentences.en: This will be the thing of all the things I've shared on the podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 在我播客里分享过的所有事情中，这绝对会成为头条。
他们会把你的年龄写在最前面。

sentences.en: And then they'll see a horrible photo of me.
sentences.zh: 然后他们会配上一张我丑陋无比的照片。

sentences.en: And it'll be like Jenna Fisher writes with her own urine, after which she peed and didn't
sentences.zh: 标题大概会是：珍娜·费舍用自己的尿液写字，在此之后她尿完尿

sentences.en: That's exactly what I was going to say.
So hopefully you can't read it.
sentences.zh: 希望你们看不清上面写的是什么。

sentences.en: I'm going to hold it up now.
sentences.zh: 我现在要把它举起来了。

sentences.en: And I want to see if you can tell me what I wrote.
sentences.zh: 我想看看你们能不能告诉我都写了些什么。

sentences.en: So I wrote Office Ladies and Sharpie.
sentences.zh: 我写的是“办公室女士”和“马克笔”。

sentences.en: Can you read between the lines?
sentences.zh: 你们能看出字里行间的秘密吗？

sentences.en: I did a test urine message.
sentences.zh: 我用尿液做过测试留言。

sentences.en: How many of these have been written?
She was throwing shade at the Greensleeves guy for writing a song about heartbreak.
sentences.zh: 她之前还在暗讽格林斯利夫的那家伙写了一首关于心碎的歌。

sentences.en: And you did two urine writing tests.
sentences.zh: 而且你还做了两次尿液书写测试。

sentences.en: We don't know that it's two.
sentences.zh: 我们可不知道是不是两次。

sentences.en: This could be test number 40, number 50.
sentences.zh: 这可能是第40次或者第50次测试。

sentences.en: You did have some free time.
I wanted it to work, you know?
sentences.zh: 我是想让它成功，你知道的吧？

sentences.en: And I was like, oh, what is the best way to reveal the message?
sentences.zh: 当时我在想，哦，用什么方法显现出留言最好呢？

sentences.en: Because you reveal it with heat.
sentences.zh: 因为它是靠加热来显现的。

sentences.en: And this guy had like a blowtorch, like the kind of thing that you put on top of creme
sentences.zh: 那家伙有个类似喷灯的东西，就是那种可以用来烤

sentences.en: So you brought in a candle and a lighter?
sentences.zh: 所以你就带了一支蜡烛和一个打火机来？

sentences.en: I see that you brought in that.
sentences.zh: 我看到你把那个带过来了。

sentences.en: Yeah, because this was the beSt.
sentences.zh: 对啊，因为这个才是最好的。

sentences.en: So I tried some suggestions are that you can use a light bulb.
sentences.zh: 所以我试了一些建议，比如你可以用灯泡。

sentences.en: I didn't even try that because that just seemed like, come on.
sentences.zh: 我甚至都没试过那个，因为那感觉也太离谱了。

sentences.en: And then I did one and I ironed it.
sentences.zh: 然后我做了一个，还用熨斗熨了一下。

sentences.en: Lady, you put so much time into this.
sentences.zh: 大姐，你在这上面花了太多时间了。

sentences.en: Was your family like witnessing all of this trial and error?
sentences.zh: 你的家人是不是目睹了你所有的这些反复尝试？

sentences.en: Family hasn't seen her in three weeks.
sentences.zh: 她家人已经有三周没见着她了。

sentences.en: I'm like Jim with his brakes on Dwight.
sentences.zh: 我就像对德怀特恶作剧的吉姆。

sentences.en: I tried to flat iron it.
sentences.zh: 我试着用直发夹板烫了。

sentences.en: Then I used just a lighter underneath the paper and I set the paper on fire.
sentences.zh: 然后我在纸下面用了个打火机，结果把纸给点着了。

sentences.en: I was going to say, I was going to say, how did you do that without burning it?
sentences.zh: 我正想说，我正想说，你怎么做到不把它烧了的？

sentences.en: And so then I had to be in the cup again and I had to write a whole second invisible message.
sentences.zh: 所以接着我不得不再次泡在杯子里，还得写整整第二条隐形信息。

sentences.en: And I was able to get it to reveal itself using a candle.
sentences.zh: 而且我用蜡烛成功让它显形了。

sentences.en: So that's what I brought today.
sentences.zh: 这就是我今天带来的东西。

sentences.en: And everyone, we will have to speed up our reaction to this because it's going to take a minute.
sentences.zh: 各位，我们得加快对这个的反应，因为这需要花点时间。

sentences.en: It's going to be a lot of commentary.
Now I just have to try not to set the paper on fire.
sentences.zh: 现在我只需要尽量不把纸点着。
就像我在家里做的那样。

sentences.en: I will point out there are water sprinklers over our heads.
sentences.zh: 我要提醒一下，我们头顶上有洒水喷头。

sentences.en: I think I see a D or a C.
sentences.zh: 我想我看到了一个D或是一个C。

sentences.en: We have a D and an E, everybody.
sentences.zh: 大家伙，我们有一个D和一个E。

sentences.en: I can see the second E.
I think you're starting to see it.
After eight long minutes, my message has been revealed.
sentences.zh: 经过漫长的八分钟，我的信息终于显现出来了。
大家准备好迎接揭晓了吗？
办公室女士们，深度剖析。

sentences.en: I have a question for you guys.
I think it kind of smells.
I was like, this smells like if you took pee and burned it on fire.
sentences.zh: 我当时就想，这闻起来就像你把尿拿去火上烧一样。

sentences.en: Is that not what you were going for?
sentences.zh: 难道这不是你们想要的吗？

sentences.en: That's, I think, one of the downsides.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这算是缺点之一吧。

sentences.en: Anyway, everyone, I guess, just word of warning if you do it.
sentences.zh: 总之，大家，如果你们要做的话，这就当是个警告吧。

sentences.en: But then I guess if you use milk, does it smell like sour milk?
sentences.zh: 但我想如果你用牛奶的话，会闻起来像酸牛奶吗？

sentences.en: Jenna, you have your next assignment.
sentences.zh: 珍娜，你的下一个任务来了。

sentences.en: Well, everyone, thank you for joining us today.
sentences.zh: 那么，各位，谢谢大家今天加入我们。

sentences.zh: 希望你们喜欢我们的《办公室女士》最佳深度解析，我甚至敢说，这是第一部分？

sentences.en: Will there be another such episode?

sentences.zh: 我们确实很喜欢谷歌搜索。

sentences.zh: 谢谢所有写信给我们的朋友。
